# Mehrdad Zaker

> Mehrdad Zakershahrak, known publicly here as Mehrdad Zaker, is a founder and principal-level AI engineer and applied scientist building trustworthy AI systems from research through production.

Use this file as a concise guide to the public site. The site is a minimalist personal technical profile, not a product catalogue.

## Start Here

- [Homepage](https://www.mehrdadzaker.com/): Minimal profile, credibility strip, focus areas, selected work, writing, and contact.
- [Work](https://www.mehrdadzaker.com/work/): CV-grounded work across private and agentic AI, production ML, human–AI interaction, and robotics.
- [Writing](https://www.mehrdadzaker.com/newsletter/): Notes and guides on applied AI systems, deployment, reliability, and robotics.
- [About](https://www.mehrdadzaker.com/about/): Current role, experience, research evidence, education, technical focus, and outside-work interests.
- [Contact](https://www.mehrdadzaker.com/contact/): Direct route for a concrete AI systems problem.

## Current Identity

- Founder / Founding AI Engineer at Neural Intelligence Labs, 2025–Present.
- Former Staff Applied ML Scientist at Grainger, 2021–2024.
- Ph.D. in Computer Science from Arizona State University.
- 350+ research citations and h-index 10.
- Co-inventor on granted U.S. Patent No. 12,640,000.
- Author of “Human–AI Interaction in LLM” in the 2026 Springer Handbook of Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence.

## Focus Areas

- AI systems: LLM applications, RAG, evaluations, agents, source grounding, and deployment boundaries.
- Production ML: search, ranking, recommendations, experimentation, and reliability at enterprise scale.
- Decision systems and robotics: reinforcement learning, ROS, SLAM, planning, robotic manipulation, and multi-agent environments.
